english_research_meaning: User-facing Scenario and atomic machine Operation have distinct purpose

original_source_line: 2. Composite scenario имеет собственную короткую форму и маппит параметры по steps.
english_research_meaning: Composite Scenario needs concise user parameters mapped explicitly to its steps

original_source_line: 3. Основная масса параметров должна иметь smart defaults; технические policy-values остаются скрытыми.
english_research_meaning: Prefer useful defaults and keep technical effect policy values out of novice forms

original_source_line: 4. Пользовательские значения сохраняются как `ParameterProfile`, а не просто случайный словарь формы.
english_research_meaning: Remembered user values should have an explicit scoped ParameterProfile identity

original_source_line: 5. Case хранит immutable snapshot фактически использованных параметров.
english_research_meaning: Actual Case/Run parameters require immutable execution-time snapshot

original_source_line: 6. Личные profiles и shared presets — разные сущности.
english_research_meaning: Personal ParameterProfiles and shared presets are different policy/ownership objects

original_source_line: 7. Cancellation — cooperative protocol, а не убийство thread.
english_research_meaning: Cancellation is cooperative and checked at safe points, not thread termination

original_source_line: 8. `cancel_requested` и terminal `cancelled` должны быть разными состояниями.
english_research_meaning: A cancel request is not itself terminal cancellation

original_source_line: 9. Уже committed success/failure нельзя переписать поздним cancel request.
english_research_meaning: Late cancel must not rewrite a committed terminal success/failure

original_source_line: 10. Force termination даёт `outcome_unknown`, пока восстановление не докажет состояние.
english_research_meaning: Forced worker termination leaves unknown effect until reconciliation establishes facts

original_source_line: 11. Shared multi-user case truth живёт на execution node, а не в локальном клиентском JSON.
english_research_meaning: Shared multiuser Case authority belongs to executing node, not one client's JSON history

original_source_line: 12. Право отменять чужой job приходит из capability/permission layer AppDock.
english_research_meaning: Cancelling another participant's Job requires verified principal-specific authorization

original_source_line: 13. Background, remote user и AI используют тот же JobManager.
english_research_meaning: Foreground/background/remote/AI use the same admitted execution authority

original_source_line: 14. AI получает только канонические operations с typed schema и side-effect metadata, а не произвольный Python/shell.
english_research_meaning: AI access limited to permitted typed domain Operations and effects, never arbitrary shell/Python

original_source_line: 15. `stratbox-windows` нужно довести до frontend-neutral application layer, чтобы те же semantics легли в будущий Android без повторного проектирования.
english_research_meaning: Platform-neutral application meaning should serve later Android without Qt duplication
